### 2026-10-13 – This was Day 1 of working on WASO. It's my first time using OnShape so it took a while to get a hang of the controls but once I did I was able to build the base housing of the bird. I spent a long tim

**6.33h**

This was Day 1 of working on WASO. It's my first time using OnShape so it took a while to get a hang of the controls but once I did I was able to build the base housing of the bird. I spent a long time looking at sketches of Albatrosses and trying to figure out the best may to model it, eventually deciding on a spline curved base with holes for wings
